blocks.html: Win Rate is the percentage of sales opportunities that result in a closed deal, calculated by dividing the number of won deals by the total number of qualified opportunities.

Win rate is a key sales performance metric used to measure how effectively a team converts opportunities into customers. A higher win rate often reflects strong qualification, effective selling, and competitive positioning.
Win rate is typically measured by:

items.html: Tracking qualified opportunities entered into the pipeline
Dividing won deals by total qualified opportunities
Reviewing results by rep, region, or segment
Identifying reasons behind wins and losses

blocks.html: Businesses use win rate to improve forecasting and sales execution.
If a sales team closes 25 deals out of 100 qualified opportunities, the win rate is 25%.
Win Rate is a core sales metric that shows how many qualified opportunities turn into closed business.
Close more deals with smarter sales strategies. MarketJoy helps businesses improve win rates through better targeting, outreach, and pipeline management.
